Its much higher Li:Zr ratio and more basic oxide framework may change how the Zr centre reacts with the sulfide, and it is worth testing whether a different Zr-O packing lowers the Zr-sulfide contact penalty.
proposal.motivation: LiZr2(PO4)3 (mp-aaabrffc) gave penalty 0.056 eV/non-Li atom (bin 2), just above the 0.05 threshold, from a Zr-sulfide contact product. The other Li-containing coatings (Li3PO4, LiAlSiO4, LiF, LiMgPO4, Li3BO3) all gave larger penalties, so a Zr-containing oxide with a different Li/Zr ratio is the closest untested lead.

proposal.hypothesis: LiCaAlF6 contains only non-reducible, fully oxidized cations (Li+, Ca2+, Al3+) and a fluoride anion. It is a wide-gap insulator with no Zr4+, Ti4+ or P5+ centre to be reduced to sulfides, so it should avoid the sulfide-driven products that gave the earlier penalties. A mixed Ca/Al fluoride is a different family from the tested phosphates, silicates, borates and LiF.
proposal.motivation: LiZr2(PO4)3 (0.056 eV, bin 2) was the best so far, but its penalty came from Zr-sulfide formation. Every other tested coating (Li3PO4, LiAlSiO4, LiF, LiMgPO4, Li3BO3, Li6Zr2O7) gave a larger penalty from sulfide-driven products. Testing a fluoride with only non-reducible cations is the next untested route to beat the 0.05 eV threshold.

proposal.hypothesis: Li2MgCl4 is a chloride with only non-reducible Li+ and Mg2+ cations. Its anion matches the Cl- already in Li6PS5Cl, so the chloride-sulfide exchange that produced SCl/SCl4 side products in the fluoride and oxide tests should be weaker. Mg2+ cannot be reduced by the sulfide, which avoided the Zr and Al/Si reduction products seen earlier. The aim is to get a penalty below the 0.05 eV/non-Li atom threshold and into a lower bin than LiCaAlF6 (bin 2).
proposal.motivation: LiCaAlF6 (mp-aaaaajby) was the first acceptable coating (penalty 0.048 eV, bin 2). Its non-reducible cations avoided the cation-reduction products that drove the oxide and phosphate penalties. The halide family with a non-reducible divalent cation is the closest untested route to a lower penalty.
